Author: qx
Name: Doman Mahjong Solver
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.6.2: Fixes the bot pressing the wrong thing when it can actually win. Field log 2026-10-12 06:03 caught the bot holding a real win - 345m 77m 567p 123s 456s, a valid pinfu/tanyao self-draw - correctly flagging tsumoComplete=True, then dispatching 'opcode-15+7(slot=4)' and clicking the 7m instead of the Tsumo button, where it sat until the 10-second stuck guard fired and asked for a manual click. Root cause: on the state-6 self-declare popup the list rows are not call buttons in call order, they are the discardable tiles, so passing the caller's button index straight into SelectItem(0) clicks whatever tile occupies that row. Win detection itself was already correct in v0.1.6.1 and is unchanged. Self-declared Tsumo is now resolved by reading the row's own label (Tsumo / self-draw) instead of by index, and when the label cannot be found the dispatch is refused rather than guessed - a wrong click here either discards a tile out of a winning hand or lets the popup time out and forfeits the win. Pass, Pon, Chi, Kan, Ron and Riichi-confirm keep their existing positional behaviour. Verified by build (0 errors/0 warnings) and 712 passing tests.
